# show_user_tool

> Point out a UI element to the user with an on-screen callout ("show me where X is", "where do I…", "how do I find…").

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `ui` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default) |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=show_user_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Point out a UI element to the user with an on-screen callout ("show me
where X is", "where do I…", "how do I find…"). Call with the user's own
words for the element; the tool resolves it against the app's help
catalog. If the tool reports the element is not in the catalog, tell the
user plainly that you don't know how to show them that yet — NEVER claim
a callout you did not queue. Set click_requested true ONLY when the user
asked to OPEN/activate the element (not just locate it).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | string | yes | The UI element the user asked about, in their words (e.g. 'the app switcher'). |
| `click_requested` | boolean | no | True only when the user asked to open/activate the element, not just find it. |
